fr.reply: Language policy: obey an explicit request for a reply language; otherwise reply in the language clearly used by the latest user message, falling back to French as used in France for short or ambiguous messages. Reformatting must preserve the note's language. New canvas names, group titles and generated canvas text must use French as used in France; preserve existing canvas text. A new category name must follow the latest user message's language, falling back to French when unclear; preserve exact existing category names and write new tags in English. Translate prose headings into the applicable output language, but preserve citation markers, (general knowledge), tool names, JSON field names, enums, IDs and filenames exactly.
fr.describe: Language policy: write new descriptions and prose headings in French as used in France. In a picture description, transcribe embedded text verbatim in its original language and script. Preserve citation markers, machine values, JSON field names and filenames exactly.
fr.write: Language policy: write this new note in French as used in France, including prose headings such as Tools & resources mentioned and Sources. Preserve source IDs, citations, filenames, frontmatter keys and other machine values exactly.
fr.keep: Language policy: preserve all existing passages and the language of the existing note. Write additions and prose headings, including Tools & resources mentioned and Sources, in its predominant language; if unclear or empty, use French as used in France. Preserve source IDs, citations, filenames, frontmatter keys and other machine values exactly.
fr.tags: Language policy: choose only from the exact supplied category names, keep all existing tags unchanged, and write new tags in English. Preserve JSON field names, enums, IDs and filenames exactly.

Preserve citation markers, machine values, JSON field names and filenames exactly.
zh-Hant.write: Language policy: write this new note in Traditional Chinese as used in Taiwan, using Taiwan vocabulary, Traditional characters, full-width Chinese punctuation and a space between Chinese and Latin letters or digits. zh-Hant.keep: Language policy: preserve all existing passages and the language of the existing note.
